name: SOCKET SET 94PCS -15145 Tolsen
category: HAND TOOLS, Sockets & Accessories
description:
KIT contains :

The SOCKET SET 94PCS- 15145 Tolsen,  is a versatile and comprehensive tool kit designed to meet the needs of both professional hand tools mechanics and DIY enthusiasts. This meticulously crafted set contains an impressive array of high-quality tools to assist you in various mechanical and maintenance tasks.

At its core, this set includes 18 standard metric sockets with 1/2″ drive, ranging in sizes from 10mm to 32mm. In addition, there are four 1/2″ deep metric sockets, with sizes 14mm, 15mm, 17mm, and 19mm, to provide greater flexibility when dealing with fasteners in tight spaces. The set’s adaptability is further enhanced by a 1/2″ universal joint, two extension bars (125mm and 250mm), and a 3-way adaptor.

For handling spark plugs, this set includes two 1/2″ spark plug sockets (16mm and 21mm). It also features a bit adaptor (1/2″ * 38mm) and a two-component ratchet handle (72 teeth) for smooth and efficient operation.

The 1/4″ section of the set comprises 13 standard metric sockets (4mm to 14mm) and eight deep metric sockets (6mm to 13mm). You’ll also find two extension bars (50mm and 100mm), a universal joint, a sliding bar (115mm), a flexible bar (150mm), and a socket handle (150mm) in this section.

The set’s versatility extends to its bits, which include 17 socket bits made from durable S2 material. The bits cover a wide range of sizes and types, including slotted, Phillips, Pozi, Torx, and hex bits, allowing you to tackle a variety of screw and bolt types. The set is completed with a 1/4″ S2 bit adaptor and 15 Cr-V bits, including various sizes of slotted, Phillips, Pozi, Torx, and hex bits.

For added convenience, all these tools are neatly organized and protected in a blow-molded case, ensuring easy transport and storage. With the Tolsen 94PCS Socket Set, you’ll have everything you need to handle a multitude of tasks with confidence, efficiency, and precision, making it an indispensable addition to your toolbox.

description:
Harden 570353 PRO Auto-Oil Glass Cutter 185mm

Achieve smooth, clean, and precise glass cutting with the Harden 570353 PRO Auto-Oil Glass Cutter. Designed for professional glaziers, glass fabricators, construction workers, and DIY enthusiasts, this premium glass cutter features an automatic oil feeding system, durable aluminum handle, and a YD05 tungsten carbide cutting wheel for exceptional cutting performance and longer service life.

Its chrome-plated construction enhances corrosion resistance while the integrated oil reservoir continuously lubricates the cutting wheel, reducing friction and delivering cleaner scoring lines with minimal effort.

Whether you’re cutting window glass, mirrors, glass panels, decorative glass, or furniture glass, this professional cutter ensures accuracy and consistent performance.

Technical Specifications

Brand                Harden

Key Features

✔ Professional Auto-Oil Design

✔ Durable Aluminum Handle

✔ High-Quality YD05 Tungsten Carbide Cutting Wheel

✔ Chrome Plated Body for Rust Protection

✔ Smooth Continuous Oil Lubrication

✔ Cleaner and More Accurate Cutting Lines

✔ Comfortable Grip for Long Working Hours

✔ Suitable for Professional and DIY Applications

✔ Long Service Life

✔ Easy to Refill Oil Reservoir

Applications

Perfect for:

 * Glass Workshops
 * Mirror Installation
 * Window Glass Cutting
 * Decorative Glass Projects
 * Furniture Glass
 * Glass Doors
 * Home Renovation
 * Interior Design
 * Construction Sites
 * DIY Glass Projects
 * Professional Glaziers

How to Use

 1. Fill the oil reservoir with suitable glass cutting oil.
 2. Clean the glass surface before cutting.
 3. Mark the desired cutting line.
 4. Hold the cutter vertically.
 5. Apply even pressure while scoring the glass in one continuous motion.
 6. Snap the glass carefully along the scored line.
 7. Clean and store the cutter after use.

Safety Instructions

 * Always wear safety glasses and protective gloves.
 * Use on a clean, flat surface.
 * Do not score the same line repeatedly.
 * Keep away from children.
 * Store in a dry place.
 * Use only recommended cutting oil.

Why Choose Harden?

Harden hand tools are trusted worldwide for their professional quality, durability, precision, and reliable performance, making them suitable for industrial, commercial, and DIY users.

name: 3M Series 290 Road Stud Cat Eye – High-Visibility Reflective Road Marker
sku: 3M Series 290 Safety Road Stud Cat Eye
category: Road Safety, SAFETY EQUIPMENT, Studs
shortDescription: 3M Series 290 Safety Road Stud features a durable glass-filled polycarbonate body and a prismatic “Cat Eye” lens with an abrasion-resistant, UV-protected coating. Built for extreme chemical and weather resistance, this non-illuminated marker provides superior, all-weather retroreflective guidance on roads and highways.
description:
Product Overview

The 3M Series 290 Safety Road Stud Cat Eye is a premium, high-performance reflective road marker designed for maximum visibility, durability, and road safety in all weather conditions. Manufactured with 3M’s advanced retroreflective technology, this marker delivers superior brightness and long-term resilience, making it ideal for highways, parking zones, and industrial sites

Technical Specifications

 * Brand: 3M

 * Model: Series 290

 * Type: Reflective Road Stud / Cat Eye

 * Body Material (Housing): Robust Glass-Filled Polycarbonate with UV protection.

 * Material Requirement: Comprised of materials with adequate chemical, water, and UV resistance for intended use.

 * Reflector Lens: Prismatic retroreflector made from polycarbonate with UV and abrasion-resistant coating

 * Base Material: Textured and embossed, substantially free of gloss for enhanced grip and adhesion

 * Chemical Resistance: Excellent resistance to water, chemicals, and solvents

 * Weather Resistance: Designed for long-term exposure to UV rays, rain, and high-temperature environments

 * Load Capacity: Tested for ≥ 13 tons of vehicular load

 * Reflectivity: ≥ 800 mcd/lux for superior night-time and low-light performance

 * Color Options: White, Yellow, Red, Blue (compliant with road marking standards)

 * Installation Method: Epoxy or bitumen adhesive

 * Packaging: Carton box with individual protection

 

6.1 Construction Requirement (04280 €.1)

According to 3M manufacturing standards and Section 04280 €.1 requirements, the Series 290 Road Marker complies with the following construction specifications:

Parameter             Specification                             Description
Body Material         Glass-filled polycarbonate                Engineered for chemical, water, and UV resistance, suitable
                                                                for outdoor and roadway environments.
Reflector Lens        Prismatic retroreflector, polycarbonate   Includes UV protection and abrasion-resistant coating for
                                                                extended clarity and reflectivity.
UV Protection         Integrated in both body and lens          Prevents discoloration and material degradation under
                                                                prolonged sunlight exposure.

shortDescription: Stainless Steel Retractable Queue Pole Crowd Control Barrier with 6FT Red or Blue belt, 35-inch height, 13-inch heavy-duty base and 4-way adaptor. Ideal for queue management, crowd control, access restriction and pedestrian guidance.
description:
Description:

The Stainless Steel Retractable Queue Pole Crowd Control Barrier is a durable and professional solution for queue management, crowd control, pedestrian guidance, and access organization. Designed with a stainless-steel pole and a stable heavy-duty base, this retractable stanchion provides an efficient way to create organized queues and controlled walking paths in busy public, commercial, and industrial environments.

The barrier features a 6-foot retractable nylon belt with a 2-inch width, available in Red or Blue. The belt can be extended from one stanchion and connected to another compatible queue pole, allowing multiple units to be arranged together for creating longer queues, entry lanes, restricted areas, or controlled access points.

Its 35-inch overall height, 2.5-inch pole diameter, and 13-inch base diameter provide a practical configuration for pedestrian-level crowd management. The heavy sand-filled and rubber base provides stability while helping protect the floor surface during regular use.

A 4-way adaptor allows the belt to be connected in multiple directions, making the system suitable for flexible queue layouts and larger crowd-control arrangements.

This retractable queue barrier is ideal for airports, banks, cinemas, restaurants, shopping malls, hotels, exhibitions, trade shows, seminars, events, factories, reception areas, and other locations where organized pedestrian movement is required.

Product Type       Retractable Queue Pole Crowd Control Barrier

Total Height       35 Inches

How to Use:

 1. Place the queue pole on a stable and level floor surface.
 2. Position the stanchion at the required starting point of the queue.
 3. Pull the retractable belt from the pole.
 4. Connect the belt to another compatible queue pole or receiving point.
 5. Use the 4-way adaptor to create straight, angled, or multi-directional queue arrangements.

Safety & Usage Instructions:

 * Always place the pole on a stable, level surface.
 * Do not use the barrier as a physical impact protection system.

Suitable for a wide range of public, commercial, event, and workplace environments.

The AFO Fire Extinguisher Ball is an innovative automatic fire suppression solution that activates instantly when exposed to flames. Applications

The AFO Fire Extinguisher Ball is ideal for:

 * Homes & apartments

 * Electrical panels & distribution boards

 * Kitchens & gas stoves

 * Offices & commercial spaces

 * Warehouses & storage rooms

 * Vehicles & generator rooms

 * Server rooms & telecom cabinets

Directions for Use (Simple & Safe)

 1. Place or mount the AFO Fire Ball near fire-risk areas (electrical panels, stoves, machinery).

 2. No wiring or installation required.

 3. In the event of a fire, the ball automatically activates upon contact with flame.

 4. The explosion disperses fire-extinguishing powder and alerts occupants.

Aluminized Fire Suit – a protective outfit for firefighters, workers, and emergency responders. It’s made of strong aluminum material and protects you from really hot temperatures, up to 500°C. Coverall style, must-have for anyone dealing with tough and risky situations.

Material & Construction

 * Outer Layer: Aluminized reflective surface that reflects up to ~95% of radiant heat away from the wearer.

 * Middle Layer: Flame-retardant moisture and thermal barrier for extended heat protection.

 * Inner Layer: Soft flame-retardant lining for comfort and added insulation.

 * Complete Coverage: Includes hood with visor, reflective jacket, trousers, gloves, and boots where applicable.

 * Certification & Standards: Designed in compliance with industry safety norms for protective heat-resistant clothing (EN ISO 11612 and related standards often applied).

Applications

This aluminum fire suit is essential for:

 * Industrial Firefighting & Proximity Heat Protection

 * Foundries & Steel Mills

 * Glass Manufacturing & Kiln Operations

 * Metal Casting & Smelting Facilities

 * Welding, Cutting, and Thermal Operations

 * Furnace Maintenance & High-Temperature Processing Areas

 * Emergency Heat/Fire Response Teams

Directions for Use

 1. Ensure full coverage: wear coat/jacket, trousers, gloves, boots, and hood.

The Manual Call Point is meant for indoor fire detection systems. It’s easy to set up and keep up. It has built-in cable paths for connecting wires easily. You’ll find the key for using it right on the device. It has a clear cover for protection and can be sealed if needed.

Technical Highlights

 * Function: Manual fire alarm activation device

 * Operation: Break-glass or push/reset button mechanism depending on model/type

 * Integration: Works with conventional or addressable fire alarm panels

 * Housing: Durable fire-resistant casing with clear labeling and visible activation element

 * Indicator: Some designs include LED indicator for status and activation feedback

 * Mounting Options: Surface or flush mounted on wall locations near exits and escape routes

 * Standards Compliance: Designed to meet common fire safety standards such as EN54-11 and other regional codes (verify specific certification per model)

Applications

The Manual Call Point is ideal for:

 * Office buildings

 * Factories and warehouses

 * Retail outlets and shopping malls

 * Hospitals and clinics

 * Schools and universities

 * Public infrastructure and high-occupancy buildings

Directions for Use

 1. Locate the Call Point: Should be installed at eye level near primary exit routes.

 2. Activate: Break the glass or press the activation button when a fire is detected.

 3. Signal: The call point sends a signal to the fire alarm control panel to trigger audible and visual alarms.

 4. Reset (if applicable): After activation, units with a resettable mechanism can be restored using a key or tool (break-glass models require glass replacement).

Key Benefits

 * Human-Activated Response: Provides a manual override to immediate alarm activation when a fire is detected.

 * Early Warning: Allows building occupants to raise the alarm before detectors may sense heat or smoke.

 * Code Compliance: Supports fire safety standards that require manual alarm initiation stations in buildings.

 * Easy to Use: Simple break glass or push mechanism ensures reliable operation even under stress.

 * Low Maintenance: Minimal upkeep with periodic testing as part of standard fire alarm inspections.

* Versatile Adhesive Tape: Ideal for sealing leaks and cracks in various surfaces.

 * Butyl Rubber Composition: Made from a special blend of butyl rubber, offering excellent waterproofing and long-lasting adhesion.
 * Strong and Flexible Backing: Conforms to irregular surfaces, ensuring a tight seal.
 * Easy Application: Requires a clean and dry surface for optimal adhesion.
 * Wide Range of Materials: Adheres to concrete, metal, plastic, glass, and wood.
 * Durable Barrier: Prevents water, moisture, and air penetration once applied.
 * Leak Repair: Effective for repairing leaks in roofs, gutters, pipes, and plumbing fixtures.
 * Sealing Joints and Cracks: Suitable for sealing seams in various construction projects.
 * Weather Resistant: Resistant to UV rays, temperature fluctuations, and harsh weather conditions for indoor and outdoor use.
 * Cost-Effective Solution: Reliable option for waterproofing and leak repairs across multiple applications.
 * Lasts up to 15 Years

Euro Butyl Waterproof Leakage Tape, also known simply as Waterproof Tape or Crack Repairing Tape, is a versatile adhesive tape designed to effectively seal leaks and cracks in various surfaces. It is commonly used in construction, plumbing, roofing, and automotive applications to prevent water infiltration and protect surfaces from moisture damage. The tape is made from a special blend of butyl rubber, which provides excellent waterproofing properties and ensures long-lasting adhesion. It typically features a strong and flexible backing material, allowing it to conform to irregular surfaces and provide a tight seal. Euro Butyl Waterproof Leakage Tape is easy to apply, requiring only a clean and dry surface for optimal adhesion. It can adhere to a wide range of materials, including concrete, metal, plastic, glass, and wood. Once applied, the tape forms a durable barrier that effectively prevents water, moisture, and air from penetrating the sealed area. This type of tape is often used for repairing leaks in roofs, gutters, pipes, and plumbing fixtures. It can also be used for sealing joints, cracks, and seams in various construction projects. Additionally, Waterproof Tape is resistant to UV rays, temperature fluctuations, and harsh weather conditions, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Overall, Euro Butyl Waterproof Leakage Tape is a reliable and cost-effective solution for waterproofing and repairing leaks and cracks in a variety of applications.

name: STP Start Stop Petrol Cleaner 200ml
category: Car Care Products, Cleaner
description:
Start-stop is a system which cuts a petrol or diesel engine when the car is stationary, in order to reduce fuel consumption and emissions. When the brake is released, or the clutch is engaged and the driver is ready to move again, the engine starts.

A normal car without automatic start-stop can be expected to go through up to 50,000 start-stop events during its lifetime. However with automatic start-stop being activated every time the car comes to a standstill, the figure rises dramatically.

The repercussion of this is start-stop engine technology is more susceptible to deposit build up. Once deposits have built up in the fuel intake system, the owner/driver of a vehicle with a start-stop engine will experience; power loss, driveability issues and exhaust emissions.

STP® Start-Stop Petrol Engine Cleaner, specially formulated to help start-stop engines run better for longer, cleans and protects key engine parts, keeps the fuel intake system clean, assists with saving fuel and reducing emissions.

Simply add to your fuel tank every 2000 miles.

 * Automotive repair and maintenance
 * Steel and metal fastening
 * Construction and installation work
 * Furniture assembly
 * Workshop and industrial use

 * Type: Penetrating lubricant with corrosion inhibitor

 * Formats Available: Spray (aerosol) and Liquid

 * Action Time: Penetrates in minutes, protects for weeks

 * Temperature Range: -30°C to +150°C

 * Water Resistance: Creates waterproof, water-repellent film

 * Materials Safe For: Metals, alloys, most plastics

Directions for Use:

 1. Shake well before use

 2. Spray directly on seized parts or corroded areas

 3. Allow 5-10 minutes to penetrate

 4. Wipe excess or leave protective film

 

VMD 48 vs. WD-40: Key Differences

✔️ VMD 48 Offers Superior Performance For:

Feature       VMD 48                                 WD-40
Protection    Long-lasting waterproof film (weeks)   Short-term protection (days)
Penetration   Deeper rust penetration (5-10 mins)    Moderate penetration
Lubrication   Heavy-duty & water-resistant           Light lubrication
Formats       Spray + Liquid options                 Spray only
Temperature   Stable at -30°C to +150°C              -20°C to +120°C

Best For Industrial Use When You Need:

 * Longer corrosion protection in humid Pakistani climates

 * Heavier rust removal on seized machinery parts

 * Waterproof lubrication for marine/outdoor equipment

name: VMD 100 HT High Temperature Paint Spray | Heat Resistant Paint up to 600°C
category: Aerosol, Automotive Aerosols, Car Care Protection, Industrial Aerosols, Maintenance, Metal Paints, Paint & Coating Aerosols, Protective Coatings, Rust Remover, Rust Remover & Penetrant Aerosols, Spray Paints, Undercoating Sprays, Zinc Protection Spray
shortDescription: VMD 100 HT is a professional high temperature paint resistant up to 600°C, ideal for exhausts, stoves, furnaces, chimneys, and metal parts.
description:
Product Overview

VMD 100 HT is a high-quality, high-coverage heat resistant paint formulated with modified silicone resins, designed to withstand temperatures up to 600°C. It is ideal for finishing, restoring, and protecting metal surfaces exposed to high temperatures but not in direct contact with open flames.

This professional-grade paint provides excellent adhesion, durability, and a uniform finish on components such as stoves, fireplaces, boilers, furnaces, chimneys, barbecues, exhaust systems, manifolds, and brake calipers. The paint dries in air; however, thermal curing at 100°C for 10 minutes is required to achieve full cross-linking and maximum heat resistance.

Key Features

 * Heat Resistance up to 600°C – Suitable for extreme temperature environments

 * Silicone Resin Based Formula – High durability and thermal stability

 * High Coverage & Excellent Adhesion – Smooth and uniform finish

 * Professional-Grade Performance – Long-lasting protection

 * Air Drying with Thermal Curing – Ensures optimal cross-linking

 * Corrosion & Wear Resistant – Ideal for metal components

 * Easy Spray Application – Even coating with minimal effort

Technical Specifications

 * Brand: VMD

 * Product Code: 100 HT

 * Product Type: High Temperature Paint

 * Resin Type: Modified Silicone Resins

 * Maximum Temperature Resistance: Up to 600°C

 * Drying Method: Air dry

 * Curing Requirement: Heat at 100°C for 10 minutes

 * Application Surface: Metal surfaces

 * Finish: Heat-resistant protective coating

 * Packaging: Aerosol spray can

Suitable Applications

VMD 100 HT is ideal for use on:

 * Stoves & Fireplaces

 * Boilers & Furnaces

 * Chimney Flues & Pipes

 * Barbecues & Grills

 * Exhaust Systems & Manifolds

 * Brake Calipers

 * Industrial & Automotive Components

⚠️ Not suitable for surfaces in direct contact with open flames.

Directions for Use

 1. Clean the surface thoroughly (remove grease, rust, and dust)

 2. Shake the can well before use

 3. Apply evenly from a suitable distance

 4. Allow to air dry

 5. Cure the paint by heating at 100°C for 10 minutes for proper cross-linking

Key Benefits

✔ Withstands extremely high temperatures
✔ Professional and durable finish
✔ Ideal for industrial, automotive, and home applications
✔ Excellent coverage with minimal paint usage
✔ Reliable performance from a trusted brand

description:
VMD 132 Anti-Slip Film Spray: Enhance Safety, Prevent Accidents

Transform slippery surfaces into safe, secure zones with VMD 132 Anti-Slip Film Spray. This innovative 400ml clear coating is engineered to provide fast-drying, durable anti-slip protection for a wide range of materials, significantly reducing the risk of falls and injuries in your home or workplace.

Technical Specifications:

Applications:

Ideal for high-traffic areas prone to slips and falls, including:

 * Bathroom and kitchen floors
 * Wet-prone areas around pools or patios
 * Garage floors and workshops
 * Ramps and walkways
 * Boat decks and marine applications
 * Industrial settings and commercial kitchens

 1. Preparation: Ensure the surface is clean, dry, and free from dust, grease, and loose particles. For best results, lightly sand very smooth surfaces to improve adhesion.

 5. Clean Up: Invert the can and spray for a few seconds to clear the nozzle if not fully empty.

 

Benefits & Why Choose VMD 132 Anti-Slip Spray:

 * Superior Safety: Dramatically reduces the risk of slips, trips, and falls on potentially hazardous surfaces.
 * Invisible Protection: Dries clear and won’t yellow, preserving the aesthetic of your floors and steps.

name: Anti-Static Wrist Strap ESD Wrist Band
category: Hand Protection, Personal Safety, SAFETY EQUIPMENT
description:
Anti-static Wrist Straps are used to prevent electrostatic discharge (ESD) by safely grounding a person working with electronic equipment or at an electronic assembly facility. It consists of a band of fabric with fine conductive fibers woven into it. The fibers are usually made of carbon or carbon-filled rubber, and the strap is bound with a stainless steel clasp or plate. They are usually used in conjunction with an ESD table mat on the workbench, or a special static-dissipating plastic laminate on the workbench surface. How does an anti-static wrist strap work? Skin contacts with conductive material on the wrist strap. Static charges building up on body are discharged to the earth through the earth system.

The wristband is woven with a soft, flexible material with conductive yarns. The static electricity is exported quickly and the belt is adjustable in size for wearing. The wristband buckle shell is made of PVC material, and the button combination can be separated at will, which is convenient and practical.

 * Bandwidth: 18mm
 * Band length: 18cm
 * Cable length: 50cm (retracted)
 * Simply wrap the strap around the wrist and clip it to a grounded source.
 * Prevent static shock in a dry environment.
 * Keep static from damaging electronic parts and types of equipment
 * Adjustable wrist strap with alligator clip tip.

The Harden 550715 Universal Joint Screwdriver Bit Holder is a must-have for professionals and DIY enthusiasts working in confined spaces. This versatile tool is engineered to provide a 25-degree angle of flex, allowing you to reach fasteners that are impossible to access with a standard bit holder.

Crafted from a combination of durable Chrome Vanadium (Cr-V) steel and lightweight aluminum, this holder is built to withstand the high torque of impact drivers and wrenches. Its industrial-strength magnet ensures maximum fastener retention, preventing dropped screws and bits. The quick-release feature allows for fast and easy bit changes, saving you valuable time on the job.

 * Recessed Corners: Drives on the flats of fasteners, minimizing shavings and rounded corners
 * Quick Release: Yes, for rapid bit changes

Unleash High-Pressure Lubrication: Applications & Use Cases

 

The Tolsen 65211 Grease Bucket Pump is a heavy-duty, manual lubrication system designed for professionals who need high-volume, high-pressure grease delivery. Its robust steel construction and massive 16 KGS capacity make it ideal for industrial, agricultural, and large-scale machinery maintenance.

 * Heavy Machinery Maintenance: Essential for lubricating large equipment, tractors, bulldozers, and industrial machinery that requires frequent, high-pressure greasing.
 * Automotive & Commercial Garages: Provides a high-volume solution for shops that service vehicles requiring large amounts of grease for chassis and joints.
 * Agricultural Use: Perfect for maintaining farm equipment, trailers, and implements where cleanliness and continuous operation are critical.
 * Industrial Workshop: A reliable manual solution for lubricating manufacturing and factory equipment.

 

Directions for Use & Benefits

Tolsen 65211 grease gun features a steel barrel that can hold up to 16 kilograms of grease. The hand-operated pump, along with a 1500 mm long hose, allows you to apply grease directly to fittings with precision and pressure. With a pressure output of 3000 PSI, it effectively services even tight or clogged grease nipples. 

 

Key Benefits:

 * High-Volume Capacity: The massive 16 KGS capacity barrel drastically reduces refilling frequency, saving time on large jobs.
 * High-Pressure Output: Delivers 3000 PSI pressure, ensuring effective lubrication, even through tough or clogged grease fittings.
 * Durable Construction: Built with a heavy-duty steel barrel for industrial strength and long-term reliability.
 * Extended Reach: The 1500mm (59-inch)  hose provides ample reach for lubricating fittings in difficult or distant locations.

description:
Achieve Perfect Fastening Every Time with HARDEN Professional 1/2″ Drive Torque Wrenches

Ensure unparalleled precision and reliability in your mechanical work with the HARDEN 1/2″ Drive Torque Wrench series (Models 538111, 538121, 538131), available exclusively at Imsons.com.pk. Engineered for professionals and serious DIY enthusiasts, these high-performance wrenches are designed to deliver exact torque specifications, preventing damage from over or under-tightening.

Key Features & Technical Specifications:

 * Unrivaled Accuracy: Each HARDEN torque wrench boasts a class-leading ±3% tolerance, ensuring precise torque application for critical fasteners. This precision helps prevent costly damage to components and ensures safety in all applications.
 * Durable & Smooth Operation: Featuring a robust 72-Teeth Chrome-Molybdenum (Cr-Mo) Ratchet Drive Head, these wrenches provide fine increments of adjustment and exceptional durability. The high tooth count allows for smaller swing arcs, ideal for working in confined spaces.
 * Ergonomic & Lightweight Design: The aluminum handle offers a comfortable grip, reducing user fatigue during prolonged use. Its lightweight yet sturdy construction enhances maneuverability and control.
 * Versatile 1/2″ Drive: The universal 1/2″ (12.5mm) square drive is compatible with a wide range of sockets, making these wrenches incredibly versatile for various tasks.

Available Models & Torque Ranges:

Item No.   Size            Torque Range (N.m)
538111     1/2″ (12.5mm)   10-110 N.m
538121     1/2″ (12.5mm)   30-210 N.m
538131     1/2″ (12.5mm)   60-330 N.m

Applications:

The HARDEN Torque Wrench series is indispensable for a broad spectrum of applications, including but not limited to:

 * Automotive Repair & Maintenance: Engine assembly, wheel lug nuts (for specific models/torque ranges), suspension components, chassis work, brake caliper bolts, spark plugs, and more.
 * Motorcycle & Bicycle Assembly/Repair: Ensuring critical fasteners are tightened to specification.
 * Industrial Machinery: Maintenance and assembly of various equipment requiring precise torque.
 * Marine Applications: Securing components on boats and marine engines.
 * General Engineering & Fabrication: Any task where accurate torque application is crucial for safety and performance.
 * DIY & Home Projects: High-precision tasks around the home and garage.

Directions For Use:

 1. Select the Correct Wrench & Socket: Choose the HARDEN torque wrench model that covers your required torque range and select the appropriate 1/2″ drive socket for your fastener.
 2. Set the Desired Torque: Rotate the handle to align the desired torque value on the scale. Lock the setting if your model has a locking mechanism.
 3. Attach to Fastener: Place the socket firmly onto the fastener.
 4. Apply Steady Force: Pull the wrench handle smoothly and steadily until you hear and/or feel a distinct “click.” This click indicates that the pre-set torque has been reached. Do not continue to pull after the click.
 5. Release & Reset: Release pressure on the wrench. For optimal accuracy and longevity, always reset the torque wrench to its lowest setting (or slightly above zero) when storing.
 6. Storage: Store in a clean, dry environment, preferably in its protective case if provided, to maintain calibration.

 * Durable Construction: Built with Cr-Mo steel and an aluminum handle for years of dependable use in demanding environments.

shortDescription: Harden 580720 is a multi-functional 12″/300mm combination square with an aluminum base. Made from hardened stainless steel, it features a rust-resistant, hard-chrome-plated blade for high-precision marking, measuring, and leveling.
description:
Technical Specifications

 

 * Brand: Harden
 * Model: 580720
 * Size: 12 inches / 300mm
 * Blade Material: High-quality stainless steel, HRC>30 (Rockwell Hardness Scale >30)
 * Blade Finish: Durably etched, hard-chrome-plated
 * Base Material: Aluminum
 * Vial: Impact-resistant level vial
 * Accuracy: Precision-machined working surfaces for improved accuracy
 * Special Features: Rust-resistant blade

 

Unleash Precision: Applications & Use Cases

 

The Harden 580720 Combination Square is an important tool for carpenters, woodworkers, metalworkers, and DIY enthusiasts who need accuracy and durability. Its versatile design makes it useful for many different tasks.

 * Marking & Measuring: Use this tool to accurately measure and mark 90° and 45° angles. The clear, etched markings on the blade are easy to read and will not fade over time.
 * Checking Squareness: Quickly and accurately check that corners are perfectly square on your projects.
 * Depth & Height Gauge: The adjustable head allows you to slide the blade to measure depths or transfer heights, making it a handy tool for setting up a saw blade or router bit.
 * Straight Edge & Ruler: Use the hard-chrome-plated blade as a reliable straight edge for drawing lines or as a standard ruler for measurements.
 * Leveling: The built-in, impact-resistant vial allows you to check for true horizontal or vertical planes with ease.

 

Directions for Use & Benefits

 

The Harden 580720 is designed for intuitive and efficient use. Simply loosen the nut on the aluminum base to slide the blade and lock it in place at your desired measurement. The hard-chrome-plated blade is both rust-resistant and durable, ensuring it can withstand the rigors of any workshop. The precision-machined surfaces and high-quality construction guarantee consistent, reliable results every time.

Key Benefits:

 * Multi-Functionality: This single tool replaces several others, serving as a square, depth gauge, straight edge, and level.
 * Superior Accuracy: Precision-machined surfaces and clear markings ensure your measurements are always on point.
 * Built to Last: The high-quality stainless steel (HRC>30) and rust-resistant, hard-chrome-plated finish provide exceptional durability and longevity.
 * Impact-Resistant Level: The built-in vial is designed to handle drops and impacts, so you can rely on it to get the job done.

description:
Unleash Industrial-Grade Cleaning Power with the Total TGT11176 High Pressure Washer

Designed for relentless performance in demanding commercial and heavy-duty environments, the Total TGT11176 High Pressure Washer is engineered to tackle the toughest grime with ease. Featuring a robust 2400W Copper Wire Induction Motor, this machine delivers a powerful 100 Bar (1450 PSI) of pressure and an impressive 10.0 liters per minute (L/min) flow rate.

Built for longevity, its industrial-grade components ensure a life expectancy of approximately 500 hours, making it an indispensable asset for workshops, construction sites, vehicle fleets, and businesses requiring consistent, powerful cleaning.

Technical Specifications:

 * Model: Total TGT11176
 * Input Power: 2400W
 * Motor Type: Copper Wire Induction Motor (Ensures extended life, quieter operation, and superior reliability for continuous use)
 * Max Pressure: 100 Bar (1450 PSI)
 * Max Flow Rate: 10.0 L/min
 * Life Expectancy: Approximately 500 hours (for commercial use)
 * Power Supply: 220-240V ~ 50/60Hz 
 * Auto Stop System: Yes (Automatically shuts off the motor when the trigger is released, saving energy and extending pump life)
 * Pump: Heavy-duty, robust pump designed for consistent high-pressure output.

 

Package Includes:

 * 1 set Metal spray gun (Durable for heavy use)
 * 1 pc High-pressure hose (steel wired), 8m (Enhanced durability and reach)
 * 4 pcs Nozzles (Variety for different cleaning tasks)

 

Shipping Details:

 * Model No.: TGT11176
 * Weight: 29.3 kg
 * Dimension: 81.5 x 52 x 57 cm (L x W x H)

 

Applications:

 * Commercial & Industrial Cleaning: Ideal for daily, heavy-duty cleaning of workshops, factories, construction sites, and industrial machinery.
 * Vehicle Fleets: Efficiently wash large trucks, buses, cars, and agricultural machinery.
 * Building & Property Maintenance: Power wash large driveways, parking areas, exterior walls, brickwork, and sidewalks.
 * Heavy Equipment: Effectively remove stubborn dirt, grease, and mud from excavators, loaders, and other construction or farm equipment.
 * Large Surface Cleaning: Perfect for extensive decking, patios, and outdoor paved areas requiring powerful and fast cleaning.
 * Farm & Agricultural Use: Cleaning barns, animal enclosures, and various farm implements.

Directions For Use:

 1. Safety First: Before operation, always wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, gloves, and sturdy, non-slip footwear. Inspect the power cable and high-pressure hose for any damage.
 2. Setup: Place the pressure washer on a stable, level surface.
 3. Water Connection: Connect a garden hose (not included) to the water inlet of the pressure washer, ensuring a secure, leak-free connection. Ensure your water supply can provide at least 10.0 L/min flow.
 4. Power Connection: Plug the pressure washer into a grounded 220-240V AC power outlet.
 5. Attach Hose & Gun: Connect the steel-wired high-pressure hose to the machine’s outlet and then attach the metal spray gun. Select and attach one of the 4 nozzles based on your cleaning task.
 6. Prime the Pump: Crucially, before turning on the power, open the water tap fully and squeeze the trigger on the spray gun for about 30 seconds to allow water to flow through the pump and purge all air. This protects the pump from damage.
 7. Start Cleaning: Turn on the pressure washer. The Copper Wire Induction Motor will provide consistent power. The auto stop system will activate the motor only when you squeeze the trigger. Maintain an appropriate distance from the surface to prevent damage.
 8. Shut Down: When finished, first turn off the pressure washer’s power switch, then turn off the water supply. Finally, squeeze the trigger on the spray gun to release any remaining pressure in the system. Disconnect all hoses and accessories.
 9. Storage: Store the unit and all accessories in a clean, dry, and frost-free environment to ensure its long 500-hour life expectancy.

 

Key Benefits.

 * True Industrial Power: The 2400W motor and 100 Bar pressure are specifically designed for commercial-grade, heavy-duty cleaning, tackling the toughest jobs with ease.
 * Exceptional Durability: Equipped with a Copper Wire Induction Motor and a steel-wired high-pressure hose, ensuring a remarkable 500-hour life expectancy for consistent commercial use.
 * Cost-Effective Longevity: Invest in a machine built to last, which reduces replacement frequency and offers better long-term value for your business.
 * Efficient Cleaning: A high flow rate of 10.0 L/min means faster cleaning of large surfaces, saving valuable time and labor costs.
 * Smart Operation: The Auto Stop System conserves energy, minimizes motor wear, and reduces operational noise, extending the life of your investment.
 * Complete Professional Kit: Includes a metal spray gun and 4 specialized nozzles, offering versatility for various cleaning challenges from the outset.

Supplied with a rip fence, push stick, and miter gauge, it offers enhanced safety and cutting control for demanding applications.

shortDescription: TOTAL TAT81501 2-in-1 pneumatic brad nailer and stapler with 18-gauge support, 15–50mm nails, and 60–100 PSI working pressure.
description:
Product Overview

The TOTAL TAT81501 2-in-1 Combo Brad Nailer is a versatile pneumatic fastening tool designed for both brad nailing and stapling applications. Ideal for woodworking, furniture assembly, cabinetry, and interior finishing, this air-powered nailer delivers reliable performance with consistent driving power.

Operating at 4–7 bar (60–100 PSI) and compatible with 18-gauge brad nails and staples, the TAT81501 is perfect for professionals and DIY users who need flexibility, precision, and efficiency in one compact tool.

Technical Specifications

 * Brand: TOTAL

 * Model No.: TAT81501

 * Tool Type: 2-in-1 Brad Nailer & Stapler

 * Spraying / Working Pressure: 4 – 7 bar (60 – 100 PSI)

 * Magazine Capacity: 100 pcs

 * Gauge Size: 18 Gauge (GA18)

 * Fastener Size: 1.25 mm × 1.0 mm

 * Brad Nail Length: 15 – 50 mm (F15 – F50)

 * Staple Length: 16 – 40 mm (J16 – J40)

 * Staple Crown Width: 5.7 mm

 * Air Inlet: Multiple 1/4″ connectors included

 * Power Source: Pneumatic (Air-powered)

 * Battery Life: Not applicable

 * Torque: Optimized pneumatic driving force

Applications

The TOTAL TAT81501 Combo Brad Nailer is ideal for:

 * Furniture making and repair

 * Cabinet assembly

 * Door and window trim installation

 * Upholstery and light framing

 * Decorative wood fixing

 * DIY home improvement projects

 * Professional carpentry and workshops

Directions for Use (Safety & Efficiency)

 1. Connect the nailer to an air compressor (60–100 PSI).

 2. Load brad nails or staples into the magazine.

 3. Adjust air pressure based on material hardness.

 4. Position the tool firmly against the work surface.

 5. Press the trigger to drive fasteners cleanly.

 6. Always wear safety glasses and disconnect air supply before reloading.

Key Benefits

 * ✔ 2-in-1 Functionality: Supports both brad nails and staples

 * ✔ Professional 18-Gauge Size: Clean, strong fastening

 * ✔ Wide Fastener Range: Nails up to 50mm, staples up to 40mm

shortDescription: Heavy-duty Harden slogging open‑end spanner (models 543451 / 543470) – forged steel, reinforced striking surface, ideal for high‑torque industrial applications.
description:
The Harden Slogging Open‑End Spanner (Models 543451 / 543470) is engineered for high-impact torque applications. This robust tool features an open-end jaw on one side and a reinforced striking surface on the other, allowing you to deliver powerful blows using a hammer. Ideal for loosening or tightening large fasteners in construction, industrial or rigging jobs.

Applications:

 * Construction and structural steel bolting

 * Rigging and large machinery maintenance

 * Scaffolding assembly or disassembly

 * Industrial maintenance where conventional wrenching fails

 * Scenarios requiring heavy torque and the leverage of a hammer

Key Features & Benefits:

 * Impact-Ready Design: The reinforced striking surface allows strong hammer strikes for maximum torque.

 * Open-End Jaw: Easily fits large nuts and bolts for versatile use.

 * Durable Build: Drop-forged steel ensures long life and resilience under repeated hammering.

 * High Torque Capability: Ideal for tough fasteners that are seized, rusted, or oversized.

 * Versatility: Combines the precision of a spanner with the power of slogging tools.

Usage & Safety Guidelines:

 1. Place the open-end jaw squarely around the fastener.

 2. Strike the reinforced end with a hammer, applying controlled blows to avoid fatigue or damage.

 3. Alternate between small taps to gradually turn the fastener.

 4. After use, inspect for nicks, cracks, or deformation on the striking end.

 5. Always wear safety gloves, eye protection, and a hard hat when working with impact tools.

 6. Store in dry conditions to prevent corrosion and preserve the striking face.

Application

Protecto Medium Strength PE Fiber Cut Resistant Gloves are becoming increasingly popular in a variety of industries, due to their ability to protect workers’ hands from sharp and dangerous objects. Below are six industries where cut-resistant gloves are commonly used:

 1. Construction: Workers in construction are often exposed to sharp objects such as nails, metal, it can provide protection, while still allowing workers to have a good grip on tools and materials.
 2. Facility Maintenance: Facility maintenance workers often come into contact with sharp objects such as broken glass, metal edges, and sharp machinery parts. Our gloves provide much-needed protection while allowing workers to perform tasks with ease.
 3. Machinery & Equipment: Workers that operate machinery and equipment are at risk of cuts and lacerations caused by sharp edges and moving parts. Our gloves provide the necessary protection to prevent such injuries.
 4. Transportation & Warehousing: Workers in the transportation and warehousing industry often handle sharp objects such as boxes, packing materials, and metal components. The gloves help prevent injuries while handling such objects.
 5. Automotive: Workers in the automotive industry often work with sharp metal edges as well as handling glass. The gloves provide protection and improve grip while performing tasks.
 6. Glass & Building Materials: Workers in the glass and building materials industry are commonly exposed to sharp glass, metal, and masonry. It provide the necessary protection to prevent lacerations and cuts.

Safety 53 Beam Light 7710 White

The Safety 53 Beam Light 7710 White is a dependable battery-operated emergency lighting solution designed to provide extended illumination during electrical power outages.

Built with a durable white housing, this emergency beam light helps maintain visibility in corridors, staircases, exit routes and critical safety pathways, making it suitable for commercial, residential and institutional environments.

With an emergency backup duration of up to 3 hours, the unit provides extended lighting support during outages. Its battery-operated design allows automatic activation during power failure, helping ensure uninterrupted emergency guidance when normal lighting is unavailable.

The compact structure supports convenient wall-mounted installation, while its stable standby performance makes it suitable for indoor emergency-lighting applications where dependable backup illumination is required.

LX-740G/R Hanging LED Emergency Exit Light

The LX-740G/R Hanging Emergency Exit Light is an LED emergency exit sign designed to provide clear exit-route identification during normal operation and electrical power failures.

It features a durable aluminum housing with a clear acrylic panel, energy-efficient LED illumination, and a rechargeable Ni-Cd battery backup capable of providing at least 3 hours of emergency operation.

The unit supports green or red EXIT illumination and operates on AC 120V / 277V, 50/60Hz. It can be installed using ceiling, backside, or end mounting, providing flexibility for different building layouts.

Magnetic directional arrow stickers are also included for configuring the required exit direction.

description:
Main Product Description

The TOTAL Heavy-Duty Mason’s Level 60cm (TMT221606) is a high-precision leveling tool designed for construction, masonry, carpentry, and general alignment tasks. Built with a robust aluminum frame, it ensures durability, lightweight handling, and accurate measurements even in tough job site conditions.

Equipped with three high-visibility vials — horizontal, vertical, and 45° — this spirit level allows for easy and accurate reading from multiple angles. The shock-resistant design and ergonomic grip make it an essential tool for professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike.

Key Features:

 * Length: 60cm (24 inches) for versatile applications.

 * High Precision: Accuracy within ±0.5mm/m for reliable readings.

 * Durable Aluminum Body: Provides strength and lightweight handling.

 * Three Vials: Horizontal, vertical, and 45° vials for multi-angle leveling.

 * Shock-Resistant Design: End caps absorb impact and protect vials from damage.

 * Easy-to-Read Markings: High-contrast scale for clear visibility.

 * Ergonomic Grip: Comfortable handling during long usage.

Specifications:

 * Brand: TOTAL

 * Model: TMT221606

 * Material: Aluminum frame with impact-resistant end caps

 * Vials: 3 (horizontal, vertical, 45°)

 * Accuracy: ±0.5mm/m

 * Length: 60cm

Applications:
Ideal for construction, tiling, masonry, carpentry, and general leveling work.

description:
Description:

Context Plus ZFP 4 Loop 40 Zone Addressable Fire Alarm Control Panel

The Context Plus ZFP Z043040NS/X/CON is an intelligent 4-loop addressable fire alarm control panel designed for advanced fire detection systems in larger commercial, industrial and institutional buildings.

It features 4 addressable loops together with 40 separate programmable zonal LED indicators, making it suitable for installations where clear zone-based alarm identification and extensive addressable device management are required. The panel is controlled through a full-colour touchscreen interface with dynamic buttons and an on-screen QWERTY keyboard.

The panel is third-party certified to EN54 Parts 2 & 4 and approved by Intertek. It incorporates advanced features including rapid loop learning, flexible cause-and-effect programming, powerful diagnostics, SafeMode, DeviceManager, programmable network architecture and intuitive PC-based configuration tools.

For larger systems, the ZFP supports high-integrity fault-tolerant RS485 networking with up to 128 network nodes, comprising up to 64 main panels and 64 Compact Controllers.

Technical Specifications:

Specification                   Details
Brand                           Context Plus
Series                          ZFP
Product Code                    Z043040NS/X/CON
Product Type                    Intelligent Addressable Fire Alarm Control Panel
Addressable Loops               4
Zonal Indicators                40 Programmable Zone LEDs
Power Supply Rating             5 Amps
Certification                   Intertek Approved
Compliance                      EN54 Parts 2 & 4
User Interface                  Full-Colour Touchscreen
Keyboard                        Virtual QWERTY Keyboard
Network Type                    High-Integrity / Single-Path RS485
Maximum Network Nodes           Up to 128
Maximum Main Panels             Up to 64
Maximum Compact Controllers     Up to 64
Peer-to-Peer Network Capacity   Up to 64 Eight-Loop Panels
Event Memory                    20,000+ Events
Custom Device Text              Up to 38 Characters Per Loop Device
Programming                     PC-Based Programming Tools
Expansion                       Optional A-Bus Expansion PCBs
Standby Capability              72 Hours + 30 Minutes Alarm
Cabinet Dimensions              450 × 462 × 127 mm
Earth Bar                       20-Way Heavy-Duty Brass Earth Bar
Loop Monitoring                 Built-In Loop Status & Current Reading
Optional Accessories            Thermal Printer, Flush-Fit Bezels, Graphic Interface
Manufacture                     United Kingdom

Recommended Applications:

The Context Plus ZFP 4 Loop 40 Zone Panel is well suited to larger addressable fire alarm installations such as:

 * Commercial buildings
 * Industrial facilities
 * Factories
 * Warehouses
 * Hospitals
 * Hotels
 * Shopping malls
 * Educational institutions
 * Office complexes
 * Multi-storey buildings
 * Large public facilities
 * Networked fire alarm systems

Key Features & Benefits:

4 Addressable Loops

The ZFP provides 4 addressable loops, allowing a substantial number of compatible addressable devices to be organised across a large fire detection system.

40 Programmable Zone LEDs

The panel incorporates 40 separate and programmable zonal LED indicators, providing clear visual zone identification.

5 Amp Power Supply

This configuration is supplied with a 5A-rated PSU, as specified for the exact model.

Intertek Approved

The panel is third-party certified to EN54 Parts 2 and 4 by Intertek.

Full-Colour Touchscreen

A user-friendly full-colour touchscreen provides dynamic controls and an integrated virtual QWERTY keyboard.

Up to 128 Network Nodes

The high-integrity RS485 networking option supports up to 128 network nodes, including:

 * Up to 64 main panels
 * Up to 64 Compact Controllers

20,000+ Event Memory

The ZFP stores more than 20,000 events, which can be filtered by fire, fault and date for easier diagnostics and maintenance review.

Flexible Cause & Effect Programming

The system supports highly flexible cause-and-effect programming, allowing fire alarm responses to be configured according to the building’s requirements.

SafeMode & DeviceManager

Advanced engineering and commissioning functions include SafeMode and DeviceManager, helping simplify system commissioning and diagnostics.

A-Bus Expansion

Optional A-Bus expansion PCBs can be used for additional I/O, relays and related system functions.

72-Hour Standby Capability

The standard cabinet is specified for 72 hours standby plus 30 minutes in alarm.

Advanced System Features:

The ZFP system also provides:

 * Automatic daylight-saving adjustment
 * Non-fire supervisory event functionality
 * Built-in loop status monitoring
 * Loop current reading
 * Optional thermal printers
 * Graphic interface facilities
 * Paging facilities
 * Removable electronics chassis
 * Multiple A-Bus expansion options
 * Flush-fit bezel options
 * Powerful PC programming utilities

Networking Capability:

The Context Plus ZFP is designed for large networked installations.

It supports:

 * High-integrity networking
 * Single-path networking
 * Up to 128 network nodes
 * Up to 64 main panels
 * Up to 64 Compact Controllers
 * Assignment of individual zones across the network

The manufacturer also states support for an up to 64 eight-loop peer-to-peer panel network capacity.

Important Installation & Usage Instructions:

Installation, programming and commissioning should be carried out by qualified fire alarm system personnel.

Use only compatible addressable devices and system accessories according to the approved system design.

Network configuration, cause-and-effect logic, programmable zoning and expansion interfaces should be configured according to project requirements.

Routine maintenance should include checks of:

 * Addressable loops
 * Zone indicators
 * Network communication
 * Power supply
 * Battery standby
 * Event history
 * Loop current
 * Connected field devices
 * Fault conditions

Cotton core sweatband with porous PU coating for maximum absorption. PH neutral, dermatologically tested.

3D Precision Fitting
Never before has such a precise fit been attainable on an industrial safety helmet, using the unique 1-2-3 point harness depth settings.

Adjustment
OneTouch™ Slip Ratchet.

Universal Slots
Enables firm fitting of a range of Surefit™ safety visors and ear defenders.

Branding
Extra large area for logos on the front, sides, and rear.

Electrical Insulation (Non-vented only)
The un-vented version conforms to and complies with EN50365 Class 0 10KV standard. This standard is applicable to electrically insulated helmets used for working live or close to live parts on installations not exceeding 1000Vac or 1500Vdc.

description:
* Best optical quality
   To provide users with the best vision possible and help them better focus on their task, Blue Eagle faceshields have passed the highest levels of optical tests (Class 1), including spherical refractive power, astigmatic refractive power, prismatic refractive power, and light diffusion.

   Both sides of the visors are furnished with protective films to ensure protection against damage or scratches during transportation. These films can be easily removed before use.

   Includes frontal and lateral impact resistance.

   Aluminum edge reinforcements can help improve visor strength. A user can also easily bend or adjust the visor to suit usage requirements.

   The faceshield is made using extrusion-grade polycarbonate (PC) with the highest specifications for mechanical strength, allowing it to withstand the impact of a 6 mm steel bead traveling at a speed of 120 m/s.

   We used advanced technologies to provide the user with superb protection against UV.
 * Resistance to ignition
   European Standard testing was used. An iron rod measuring 6 mm in diameter and 300 mm in length was heated at one end to a temperature of 650℃. The heated end was pressed against the sample surface using its own weight for 5 seconds. The faceshield did not catch fire nor glow red.
 * Quick and easy visor replacement
 * Made in Taiwan

This disposable N95 particulate welding respirator helps provide respiratory protection for applications such as welding or soldering where metal fumes may be present. The 3M™ Cool Flow™ Valve and fully adjustable straps provide added comfort.

The lightweight, disposable N95 particulate respirator is designed to help provide respiratory protection for applications such as welding, soldering and other operations in which metal fumes may be present. 3M uses a variety of innovative technologies and features to help you meet your respiratory protection and comfort needs. The specially designed cake resistant filter media provides longer resiprator life. The respirator incorporates 3M’s proprietary technology with advanced electrostatically charged microfiber filter media, designed for ease of breathing.

The proprietary 3M™ Cool Flow™ Exhalation Valve helps reduce heat build up inside the respirator to help keep the wearer more comfortable. These combined features, along with the soft nose foam and fully adjustable straps are designed to help enhance user comfort and may increase wearability.

 * N95 Approved filtering facepiece particulate respirator for certain non oil based particles
 * 3M™ Cool Flow™ Exhalation Valve
 * Cake resistant filter media
 * Flame resistant as demonstrated per modified ASTM D2859 (not a substitute for a faceshield)
 * Compatible with a variety of protective eyewear and hearing protection
 * Adjustable noseclip helps provide a custom and secure seal
 * Fully adjustable headstraps help provide a secure fit
 * Suggested applications: Welding, torch cutting, brazing, soldering, and metal pouring

WARNING: These respirators help reduce exposures to certain airborne contaminants. Before use, the wearer must read and understand the User Instructions provided as a part of the product packaging. In the U.S., a written respiratory protection program must be implemented meeting all the requirements of OSHA 1910.134 including training, fit testing and medical evaluation. In Canada, CSA standards Z94.4 requirements must be met and/or requirements of the applicable jurisdiction, as appropriate. Misuse may result in sickness or death. For proper use, see package instructions.

name: Blue Eagle BP65 Bump Cap
category: Face & Head Protection, Personal Safety, SAFETY EQUIPMENT
shortDescription:
Key Features:

– Lightweight bump cap for protection against accidental bumps.

– Designed for extended wear without causing exhaustion.

– Not suitable for protection against objects falling from great heights.

– 4-point harness design improves force distribution for reduced impact damage.

– Meets European standards for shock absorption (15kN) and penetration protection.

– Made in Taiwan
description:
Description

 * Bump Cap BP65
 * Application
   Bump caps can be used to protect the user against injuries caused by accidental bumping against fixed and hard objects.
   Bump caps are lightweight protective helmets that can be worn for extended periods of time without exhaustion. The purpose of the design is to protect the user against accidental bumping against fixed and hard objects such as racks, beams, suspended objects in the workplace, and other relevant injuries when the wearer is engaged in walking, raising the head, lowering the head, bending over, or other forms of movement.
   The bump cap is inadequate against impact caused by objects falling from a great height.In workplaces with such risks, such as construction yards, the bump cap should not be worn and instead should be replaced with the safety helmet.
 * Shock absorption
   In the event of impact, the 4-point harness design is capable of improving the distribution of the force over the entire head to reduce the damage caused by the impact.
   According to standard testing methods provided in European standard, a standard 5 kg striker is dropped from a height of 250 mm to hit the safety helmet. The helmet should afford sufficient protection to the wearer’s head and ensure that the force of impact transmitted to the head does not exceed 15kN.

Penetration Protection
According to standard testing methods provided in European standard, a standard 500 g puncture striker is dropped from a height of 50 mm to hit the safety helmet. The helmet should afford sufficient protection to the wearer’s head and prevent any injury caused by the puncture hammer.

name: Oxy-Acetylene Gas Economizer Valve
category: Metal Working, POWER TOOLS, Welding Accessories, Welding Equipment & Accessories, Welding Tool
shortDescription: Save up to 50% on Oxy-Acetylene gas with our UK-Made economizer! Features auto shut-off & instant re-ignition, boosting productivity and safety. Essential for any workshop.
description:
Oxy-Acetylene Gas Economizer Valve.

Eliminate gas waste and the complications associated with torch adjustments with the Oxy-Acetylene Gas Economizer Valve, a product proudly manufactured in the United Kingdom. This valve serves as an effective solution for enhancing the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of welding and cutting processes. It is meticulously engineered to automatically cease gas flow when the torch is not in operation, while providing instant re-ignition when required. By utilizing this essential tool, users can conserve valuable time and significantly diminish gas consumption. Experience seamless functionality, exceptional British craftsmanship, and optimize productivity with each project undertaken.

 

Technical Specifications:

 * Product Type: Oxygen and Acetylene Gas Economiser
 * Manufacturing Origin: Made in UK for superior quality and reliability.
 * Gas Compatibility: Oxygen (O2) and Acetylene (C2H2)
 * Functionality: Automatic gas shut-off when torch is not in use; instant re-ignition via hooked arm feature.
 * Mounting: Pre-drilled holes in the base for secure surface mounting (e.g., workbench, wall).
 * Inlet/Outlet Connections:
   * Oxygen: 3/8″ BSP Right-Hand Thread
   * Acetylene: 3/8″ BSP Left-Hand Thread
 * Construction: Durable, high-quality construction for long-lasting performance in demanding workshop environments.
 * Weight: 900 GRMS
 * Dimensions: L 26.5 x W 8.5 x H 15

 

Applications:

 

Gas Economizer is an indispensable tool for a diverse range of industries and applications, including:

 * Metal Fabrication & Welding Workshops: Essential for high-volume cutting, welding, brazing, and soldering tasks, ensuring precision and efficiency.
 * Automotive Repair & Restoration: Ideal for precise work on vehicle frames, exhaust systems, and body panels, benefiting from reliable performance.
 * Construction & Demolition: Streamlines on-site metalwork and structural modifications with consistent gas management.
 * HVAC Systems Installation & Repair: Perfect for efficient brazing of copper tubing and other metal components, offering a professional finish.
 * Art & Sculpture: Allows for intricate metal artistry with controlled flame management, ensuring detailed work.
 * Vocational Training Centers: Enhances safety and efficiency in welding and cutting education with a robust, reliable tool.

 

Directions For Use:

 

 1. Mounting: Securely mount the Gas Economizer to a stable surface (workbench or wall) using appropriate fasteners through the pre-drilled holes in the base.
 2. Gas Supply Connection: Connect the oxygen hose from your Oxygen regulator to the economizer’s Oxygen inlet (3/8″ BSP Right-Hand Thread). Connect the acetylene hose from your Acetylene regulator to the economizer’s Acetylene inlet (3/8″ BSP Left-Hand Thread). Ensure all connections are tight and leak-free.
 3. Torch Hose Connection: Connect your torch’s oxygen hose to the economizer’s Oxygen outlet and the acetylene hose to the Acetylene outlet.
 4. Initial Gas Flow & Pilot Flame: Open your main oxygen and acetylene cylinder valves and adjust your regulators to the desired working pressures. Briefly push down the hooked arm of the economizer to allow gas flow to the torch. Light the torch to establish a stable pilot flame, then release the hooked arm. A small, steady pilot flame will remain at the economizer’s nozzle.
 5. Operation (Welding/Cutting): When you’re ready to weld or cut, simply push down the hooked arm. Gas will flow to your torch, allowing you to ignite and begin your work.
 6. Economizing (Idle): When you temporarily stop working, release the hooked arm. The main gas flow to your torch will automatically shut off, leaving only the small, efficient pilot flame burning at the economizer. This saves gas and eliminates the need to manually adjust torch valves.
 7. Shutdown: When you are finished with all work, close the main valves on your Oxygen and Acetylene cylinders. Bleed the lines by briefly opening the economizer arm until the pressure gauges read zero. Finally, extinguish the pilot flame on the economizer.

Benefits:

 * Drastically Reduce Gas Costs: Save up to 50% or more on your Oxygen and Acetylene consumption by eliminating gas wastage during idle periods. A rapid return on investment is guaranteed!
 * 🇬🇧 Premium UK Quality: Manufactured in the United Kingdom, ensuring superior craftsmanship, durability, and reliable performance that meets stringent international standards.
 * ⚡️ Boost Productivity & Save Time: The instant auto-ignition via the hooked arm means no more constant relighting or valve adjustments, allowing you to focus on the task at hand and complete jobs faster.
 * ✅ Enhanced Operational Safety: Minimizes the risk associated with unattended open torch flames and reduces the need for manual torch lighting, promoting a safer working environment.
 * 💪 Prolong Equipment Lifespan: Reduces wear and tear on your regulators and torch by preventing continuous gas flow and frequent manual adjustments.
 * ⚙️ Seamless Workflow: Experience a smoother, more efficient work process with quick stops and starts, making your welding and cutting tasks more manageable.
 * 🇵🇰 Proudly Available in Pakistan: Get genuine Imsons quality with reliable delivery across Pakistan, ensuring you have the tools you need when you need them.

description:
Our Fast Drying Contact Cleaner is a non conductive spray that is suitable for use on all sensitive electrical components. It provides excellent cleaning with minimal fuss, and removes dirt, dust, condensation and flux residue with ease.

Simply spray on and allow the product to dry before powering up. Our fast drying electrical contact cleaner spray is ideal for use on circuit boards, switches, even spark plugs and tape heads. It will remove all the contaminants that cause current leakage and component failure.

description:

Just pour & go

K-Seal couldn’t be simpler to use. Just shake the bottle, add the fluid to your coolant system, and run your engine as normal. K-Seal’s unique formula will seek out holes and cracks, and permanently seal them, with no adverse impact on the efficiency of your engine cooling.

Uses:

 * Fixes leaks in the radiator, heater core, water pump casing

Benefits:

 * Permanent coolant leak repair

 * No need to drain or flush the cooling system

 * Quick and easy application—just shake and pour

 * Compatible with all types of antifreeze/coolant

 * Saves time and money on costly repairs

How To Use K-Seal

1. Shake the bottle vigorously and add the entire contents to the radiator or header/expansion tank

If adding to the radiator do not pour directly onto the radiator core. K-Seal products are compatible with all types of antifreeze / coolant and are not affected by other additives that may already be in the cooling system.

It does not matter if you add K-Seal products to a cold or hot engine but take care when working with a hot engine.

For very small cooling systems e.g. motorbikes, it is possible to add just part of the bottle but you must make sure that the contents are extremely well mixed first.

2. Run the engine up to operating temperature

The quickest way is to take the vehicle for a gentle drive otherwise leave the engine idling until the temperature gauge reaches the normal level.

3. Either replace the cooling system contents or leave K-Seal in the system

After K-Seal has made a repair it is not necessary to leave it in the system because the repair is permanent. You can either choose to replace the contents of the cooling system or leave the original K-Seal product in the system.

Important:

Please use extreme caution when working on a hot cooling system as hot coolant and gases could cause injury. If in doubt please consult a qualified mechanic.
